posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users TechCrunch AI · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 52m ago • Binance Agent OS enables AI agents to execute trades on the platform using ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor. • User responsibility remains high for monitoring and controlling agent behavior on the platform. • Binance has integrated multiple AI coding models into its trading infrastructure.
